en-CA.name: Hassoun
en-CA.summary: Prayer times, live countdowns, Hijri dates, Echo Show dashboard and next-prayer widget.
en-CA.description: Hassoun is an Islamic companion for prayer times and Islamic dates. On screen devices, open Hassoun for a prayer dashboard with a live countdown. Install the Hassoun Next Prayer widget for glanceable next-prayer information. You can also ask Hassoun to set reminders for the next prayer.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Hassoun when Maghrib is
Alexa, ask Hassoun how long until Fajr
